findings.title: Materials' 123% growth bet is extreme
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.22x forward against 38.35x trailing, a 55 percent compression that implies 123 percent earnings growth. That is the market pricing a doubling of profits, a far more aggressive assumption than any other sector's implied growth.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward multiple is a lie
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E sits at the 50th percentile of its five-year range while its trailing multiple is at the 86th. The 37-point gap between lenses is the widest of any sector, signaling analysts expect a sharp earnings rebound that the market is not yet paying for.

findings.title: Real Estate's valuation collapse is accelerating
findings.body: Real Estate's forward percentile has dropped 32 points in a month and 25 points in a week, landing at the 25th percentile. The forward P/E of 35.69 is still the highest of any sector, so the de-rating is happening from an extreme level that still leaves it expensive.
